text:
joan (People Ops): quick thought 121212 run a 'Thank You Postcard' writing party the week after performance reviews wrap. target: managers write short notes to folks who went the extra mile this cycle. low-cost, high-touch. yay or nay?

rafael (People Ops Coordinator): yay. could pair with a mini pop-up snacks table in HQ and a virtual scribe kit for remote managers.

nina (Events): I can do 2x sessions: Wed lunch (12-1) and Thurs 4-6pm. will need blank postcard print + envelopes + a stamp run.

emily (People Ops): tie this to spot-award nominations: encourage managers to nominate while they write. we can have QR code on the postcard back that links to the nomination form.

tom (Legal): quick compliance check: do postcards imply compensation or gifts? small note: <$10 per person is fine, but don't mention monetary awards. keep messaging appreciation-only.

joan (People Ops): good call. postcard copy should be appreciation-only. draft front/back copy?

rafael (People Ops Coordinator): draft back (short):
``` 
Thanks for bringing your best this quarter. Your work matters — thanks for all you do.
Want to nominate for a Tiny Triumph or Spot Award? Scan the QR: <short.link/nominate>
```

nina (Events): printing specs: 4x6 postcard, matte, 14pt cardstock, qty: 300 US, 120 EU, 50 APAC. vendor rec: printhappy.co (2-3 business days) or fastprint.io if we need rush. estimated cost: $0.60/card + shipping.

emily (People Ops): timeline: we need cards in-hand by 1972470000 so managers can send the week after reviews. can vendors meet that?

rafael (People Ops Coordinator): ordering now would hit that. I'll put a small PO for printing + stamps. also need a CSV with manager name -> office to prepare envelope labels.

joan (People Ops): can we get personalization where managers sign their name printed on the postcard (e.g., "From: Manager Name") so they only write a sentence? reduces writer's block.

nina (Events): variable data printing is +$0.12/card but we can do it for the 370 manager-facing cards (not entire run). or we can print blank and provide pre-printed sticker labels with manager names. cheaper.

tom (Legal): sticker labels fine. confirm no PII leakage. labels should only include first name and team.

emily (People Ops): sticker labels it is. ops note: remote managers can request a pre-stamped envelope kit shipped to them. add a checkbox on the sign-up form.

mailroom-bot: reminder scheduled 1972471000: collect manager CSV and finalize PO.

rafael (People Ops Coordinator): logistics checklist: 1) confirm art (nina) 2) finalize print qty & vendor (rafael) 3) stickers CSV (emily) 4) stamps & packing (mailroom) 5) volunteer packers for HQ drop (nina).

joan (People Ops): copy for Slack announcement: short and actionable. draft: "Join our Thank You Postcard sessions to write a quick note of appreciation and kick off spot-award nominations. Sign up link -> <forms.redwood/thankyou>" feedback?

emily (People Ops): perfect. add "virtual kit" mention for remote.

nina (Events): I'll open the signup and volunteer sheet. volunteers get snacks + extra recognition on our internal channel.

joan (People Ops): love it. final Q: budget split? proposing $400 culture budget + $150 spot-award admin for stamps & printing. approve?

emily (People Ops): approve.

tom (Legal): approved messaging as long as we avoid reward language.

joan (People Ops): great. I'll post the Slack announcement and close the loop here once the PO is sent. thanks team :sparkling_heart:
